ValidationRule.description: US-29: an instalment opportunity, at any stage, needs a duration of 1-12 months and a down payment of at least 30% of the sale price.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Mode__c, "Instalment"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISCHANGED(Payment_Mode__c), ISCHANGED(Instalment_Term_Months__c), ISCHANGED(Instalment_Down_Payment__c)), OR( ISBLANK(Instalment_Term_Months__c), Instalment_Term_Months__c < 1, Instalment_Term_Months__c > 12, ISBLANK(Instalment_Down_Payment__c), Instalment_Down_Payment__c < 0.3 * Sale_Price__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Instalment opportunity: enter the Instalment Duration (1 to 12 months) and a Down Payment Agreed of at least 30% of the sale price.
